import { initializeApp } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.2.0/firebase-app.js'; import { getFirestore, doc, getDoc } from 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/11.2.0/firebase-firestore.js'; const firebaseConfig = { apiKey: "AIzaSyBwPVFLEYyJBJEjNMVJZWYvVxOPYpqrKGg", authDomain: "nordic-sauna-map.firebaseapp.com", projectId: "nordic-sauna-map", storageBucket: "nordic-sauna-map.firebasestorage.app", messagingSenderId: "1029751773859", appId: "1:1029751773859:web:4e5e5c5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e" }; const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig); const db = getFirestore(app); // Fetch branding immediately (async () => { try { const brandingRef = doc(db, 'configs', 'branding'); const brandingSnap = await getDoc(brandingRef); if (brandingSnap.exists()) { const data = brandingSnap.data(); // Update title immediately if (data.siteName) { document.getElementById('page-title').textContent = data.siteName; } // Update favicon immediately if (data.logoUrl) { document.getElementById('favicon').href = data.logoUrl; } } } catch (err) { console.error('Early branding fetch failed:', err); } })();
